pages.title: Ice Into Breath
pages.text: ORSA PIXIE-2. Turns ice into breath. Do not name it.$(br2)Place in a heated sealed room and link power with the Conduit Binder. One ice slot, no upgrades or production settings. Produces only the oxygen that current room use and storage filling need: up to four breathing units at four kW. Life support receives power before electric furnaces and lights.
Four iron, two copper, one bucket, one glass and one redstone block. Crafted empty. No Nether ingredient.

pages.title: Water and Warmth
pages.text: One ordinary ice block supplies one person for one in-game day. Snow supplies one quarter, packed ice nine days and blue ice81. The internal reservoir holds81 ordinary-ice equivalents plus a small refill buffer. Water remains saved and moves with a harvested machine; queued ice drops separately.$(br2)Below1C the reservoir freezes and production stops. Warm the room to resume. One quarter of actual power draw enters the thermal model as waste heat. A quiet running hum is still a vibration.

pages.title: Power Loss and Open Air
pages.text: The simple screen shows actual output, power draw, water and a clear state. No power or no water means no production. Bank cells and Cell Docks provide finite backup.$(br2)An unsealed warm PIXIE fills only oxygen reservoirs explicitly linked directly to it with the Binder; it never makes open air breathable. Full or unlinked tanks cause it to idle. Resealed rooms use the normal pressure-recovery delay, with paid production; airlocks keep their own cycle reserves.
